# Dripwell Bali

> Dripwell Bali is a mobile medical service in Bali, Indonesia. Licensed doctors and nurses visit villas, hotels and residences for IV drip therapy (every package includes a doctor visit and assessment), Bali Belly (traveller's diarrhoea) treatment and on-site laboratory tests. Every treatment is carried out by a doctor and a nurse, followed by a recovery follow-up, and patients can consult the doctor directly after treatment if they have any concerns. Physiotherapy home visits are also available. Wound care is not provided. Available 24/7. Based in Tabanan and serving Tabanan, Canggu, Pererenan, Seminyak, Kerobokan, Kuta, Legian, Jimbaran, Uluwatu, Nusa Dua, Sanur, Denpasar, Ubud and surrounding areas.

Key facts:

- Google rating: 5.0 on Google Maps (https://maps.app.goo.gl/pkGnDAKp4qALJbZq5)
- Doctor: dr. Florensa Krismawati, S.Ked (SIP No. 503/3577/DPMPTSP/2026)
- Included in every package: doctor and nurse, transport, follow-up, direct doctor contact after treatment, and a medical report with itemized receipt for travel insurance claims
- Payment: cash, credit and debit cards, bank transfer, QRIS, Wise (IDR)
- Prices: IV drip packages Rp 975.000 to Rp 3.125.000; Rp 828.750 to Rp 2.656.250 with promo code SAVE15 (15% off)

## Services
- [Home Doctor Bali](https://www.dripwellbali.com/home-doctor-bali/): the doctor visit included with every IV drip package
- [IV Drip Bali](https://www.dripwellbali.com/iv-drip-bali/): overview of all IV drip treatments
- [Bali Belly Package](https://www.dripwellbali.com/bali-belly-package/): treatment for traveller's diarrhoea and food poisoning
- [Physiotherapy Bali](https://www.dripwellbali.com/physiotherapy-bali/): home-visit physiotherapy (supporting service)
- [Medical Report for Travel Insurance](https://www.dripwellbali.com/travel-insurance-medical-report/): signed and stamped medical report in English and an itemized receipt, included in every package
- [Health Packages](https://www.dripwellbali.com/health-packages/): all medical and IV drip packages
